description: Hardware Hacking Village focuses on embedded hardware exploration, printed circuit board assembly, soldering fundamentals, and physical microcontroller security. Talks cover soldering workshop kits, HackerBox component builds, foundational hardware hacking techniques, and keystroke injection hardware.

talks.title: Learn to Solder the Badge Buddy Kit
talks.teaser: Guides viewers through essential soldering skills and through-hole component assembly using the Badge Buddy kit.

talks.title: HackerBox 0057 Build
talks.teaser: Walks through unboxing, assembling, and programming the HackerBox 0057 hardware electronics project.

talks.title: Hardware Hacking 101
talks.teaser: Provides an introductory primer on hardware reverse engineering, circuit analysis, and common physical attack vectors.

talks.title: Onkeypress Hack
talks.teaser: Demonstrates physical keystroke injection attacks and hardware implants exploiting USB Human Interface Devices.
